entries.speaker: Scared Volleyball Player
entries.en: What?

entries.speaker: Scared Volleyball Player
entries.en: Are you skipping out on the volleyball[n]rally? I guess I expect it from you, transfer.
entries.uk: Прогулюєш волейбольний турнір?[n]Від тебе, новенький, іншого й не чекав.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hey, that's the guy who was over at that[n]castle.
entries.uk: О, це ж той хлопець, що був[n]у тому замку.

entries.speaker: Scared Volleyball Player
entries.en: You too, Sakamoto!?

entries.speaker: Scared Volleyball Player
entries.en: What do you guys want?
Are you getting abused?
How did you get injured?

entries.speaker: Scared Volleyball Player
entries.en: What!? Wh-What are you saying?[n]No, of course not!
entries.uk: Що?! Щ-що ти таке кажеш?[n]Ні, звісно ж ні!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: It's Kamoshida, ain't it?

entries.speaker: Scared Volleyball Player
entries.en: It's from practice! What does that have to[n]do with anything?
entries.uk: Це з тренування! До чого тут[n]це взагалі?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Kamoshida did it to you, right?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Look, I ain't gonna tell anyone you[n]squealed.
entries.uk: Слухай, я нікому не скажу,[n]що ти розколовся.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Just tell us about how Kamoshida's[n]abusin' you.
entries.uk: Просто розкажи, як Камошіда[n]з вас знущається.

entries.speaker: Scared Volleyball Player
entries.en: I-I don't know what you're talking about!
entries.uk: Я-я не розумію, про що ви!

entries.en: Are you afraid?
You're a coward.

entries.speaker: Scared Volleyball Player
entries.en: I'm not! You guys are talking complete[n]nonsense!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Don't try n' hide it! We already know!
entries.uk: Та не викручуйся! Ми вже все знаємо!

entries.speaker: Scared Volleyball Player
entries.en: You... You know? You have proof?
entries.uk: Ви... Знаєте? У вас є докази?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Well, uh... I...

entries.speaker: Scared Volleyball Player
entries.en: This is ridiculous.

entries.speaker: Scared Volleyball Player
entries.en: Please, leave me alone. You're really[n]bothering me!
entries.uk: Будь ласка, дайте мені спокій.[n]Ви мені дуже заважаєте!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...All right, that's enough. C'mon, let's go.

entries.speaker: Scared Volleyball Player
entries.en: ...Didn't I tell you to leave me alone?
